title: SCS-001 — Wire publish-ledger writes into pipeline-registry (code-demo + entertainment never delivered)
rationale: scs001-pipeline PM2 runs batch-produce --pipeline all (all 3: educational, code-demo, entertainment) but pipeline-registry.ts never writes to publish-ledger.jsonl. Only multiformat pipeline and old hailuo pipeline write to the ledger. Fix: add logToPublishLedger() call in runPipeline() so all 3 batch pipelines get their videos queued for auto-deliver to Telegram.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/pipeline-registry.ts, add logToPublishLedger() function that appends a publish-ledger entry after each successful runPipeline() call. Entry format: {video_id, video_path, published_at, title, duration_s, cost_usd, source, pipeline}. Call it after logMetrics() in runPipeline().
